name: Consequence land (money beat)
role: Fired at the full-tier consequence-beat land — the punctuation as a big money outcome settles onto the ledger. accent('consequence') in ConsequenceBeat's `land` phase, replacing the generic thump on the flagship (full-tier) events only.
emotionalTarget: weight, finality, resolution — the number has landed and the ledger is closed

leitmotif.shape: stepwise descent resolving to the tonic A — the figure 'coming to rest'; deliberately the mirror of the ascending, celebratory `mastered`/`levelup` arps

harmony: Am (settle: A2 / E3 / A3 / C4, held 1 measure)

loop.note: Not a loop. A single grid-quantized accent fired on `land`; each synth voice disposes itself. Quantized to the next 8n via the shared accent scheduler so it locks to the running Transport.

voices.impact: Tone.MembraneSynth A1 half-note (-3dB) + white NoiseSynth transient (0.14s, 160Hz highpass, -14dB) — the deep tonic stamp + paper texture.
voices.motif: arpAccent triangle E5-D5-C5-A4, 0.07s step, -9dB — the resolving descent.
voices.settle: PolySynth triangle Am chord (A2/E3/A3/C4), 1 measure, -12dB — the low, quiet close.

intensityLayers: None — a one-shot. Only fires on the full tier (|Δmoney| >= $1,000 or >= 10% of net worth); the minor tier stays lighter per the bookends/fatigue rule (section 1.2).

cuePoints.land: accent('consequence') at land+60ms, layered under the existing tonal stampGood/stampBad and the cash sfx so gain/loss color is preserved.

transitions.in: Beat already running the `gameplay` bed; the accent sits on top, no phase change.

accessibility: Respects global mute (routed through the accent bus / master gain). Silent until a user gesture starts the engine. Under prefers-reduced-motion the beat renders its final state with no ceremony and does not fire the cue (no motion, no cue churn).
originality: Original generic tonal voicings composed for this engine — a descending Am resolution. No transcribed, sampled, or copied melodies/beats/riffs.
license: Original work, in-repo synth. No third-party samples or external sources.

qc.noClipping: voices sum well under 0dBFS (impact 0dB membrane, motif -9dB, settle -12dB) on the accent bus which pre-masters; verify no >0dBFS when stacked with stampGood/Bad + cash
